# CLI reference

Every `bob` command, generated from the same help text `bob --help` prints.

## Daily workflow

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`bob capture`](capture.md) | Capture tasks, bullets, record notes, and Pomodoro commands into the vault |
| [`bob freshness`](freshness.md) | Walk the tiered freshness review queue |
| [`bob plan`](plan.md) | Show today's plan budget, Today's tasks, and NEXT/PENDING lanes |
| [`bob pomodoro`](pomodoro.md) | Show Pomodoro status, print the tmux line, or notify on completion |
| [`bob pomodoro notify`](pomodoro.md#bob-pomodoro-notify) | Notify when the current Pomodoro is complete |
| [`bob pomodoro status`](pomodoro.md#bob-pomodoro-status) | Show the current Pomodoro status (default) |
| [`bob pomodoro tmux`](pomodoro.md#bob-pomodoro-tmux) | Print the Pomodoro status and plan meter for tmux |
| [`bob ready`](ready.md) | Show each area/project note's Ready lane against the per-note cap |
| [`bob stats`](stats.md) | Show derived daily metrics as a glance, detail chart, or catalog |
| [`bob stats metrics`](stats.md#bob-stats-metrics) | List metric ids, kinds, and definitions |
| [`bob stats overview`](stats.md#bob-stats-overview) | Show the weekly glance (default) |
| [`bob stats show`](stats.md#bob-stats-show) | Show one or more metrics in detail |
| [`bob types`](types.md) | Manage task types and explain task suggestions |
| [`bob types color`](types.md#bob-types-color) | Pin or unpin a type's hue |
| [`bob types hide`](types.md#bob-types-hide) | Hide types from Recent suggestion rows |
| [`bob types list`](types.md#bob-types-list) | List remembered task types (default) |
| [`bob types migrate`](types.md#bob-types-migrate) | Rewrite legacy theme spellings to type in one commit |
| [`bob types rename`](types.md#bob-types-rename) | Rename a task type everywhere in one commit |
| [`bob types split`](types.md#bob-types-split) | Split one task type across selected entries in one commit |
| [`bob types suggest`](types.md#bob-types-suggest) | Explain the suggested type for a task or capture route |
| [`bob types unhide`](types.md#bob-types-unhide) | Show hidden types in Recent suggestion rows again |

## Tasks and projects

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`bob projects`](projects.md) | List and sync project notes via their ^prj tasks |
| [`bob relations`](relations.md) | List, hide, unhide, and rename relation labels |
| [`bob relations hide`](relations.md#bob-relations-hide) | Hide relation labels from suggestions |
| [`bob relations list`](relations.md#bob-relations-list) | List relation labels in the vault (default) |
| [`bob relations rename`](relations.md#bob-relations-rename) | Rename a relation label everywhere in one commit |
| [`bob relations unhide`](relations.md#bob-relations-unhide) | Show hidden relation labels in suggestions again |
| [`bob task`](task.md) | Vault-wide task maintenance: archive, merge, move, reconcile, reroll, split |
| [`bob task archive`](task.md#bob-task-archive) | Move done and canceled tasks from area and project notes |
| [`bob task merge`](task.md#bob-task-merge) | Fold tasks into a task, drawer, or note section |
| [`bob task move`](task.md#bob-task-move) | Move open tasks between notes and repair vault links |
| [`bob task reconcile`](task.md#bob-task-reconcile) | Reconcile task statuses from the Pomodoro ledger and dependencies |
| [`bob task reroll`](task.md#bob-task-reroll) | Re-roll due prioritized tasks within their priority windows |
| [`bob task split`](task.md#bob-task-split) | Split task notes into linked tasks |

## Vault

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`bob articles`](articles.md) | Format and inspect article notes with bob-owned section numbers |
| [`bob attachments`](attachments.md) | Copy files into the vault and show where copies came from |
| [`bob attachments import`](attachments.md#bob-attachments-import) | Copy image and file paths into the vault |
| [`bob attachments origin`](attachments.md#bob-attachments-origin) | Show where a vault attachment came from |
| [`bob nightly`](nightly.md) | Run nightly maintenance: vault-sync, task archive, articles, period notes, notebooks, vault-sync |
| [`bob notebooks`](notebooks.md) | Inspect or maintain notebook notes |
| [`bob notebooks check`](notebooks.md#bob-notebooks-check) | Check notebooks against the contract |
| [`bob notebooks create`](notebooks.md#bob-notebooks-create) | Create a notebook and its catalog rows |
| [`bob notebooks list`](notebooks.md#bob-notebooks-list) | List notebooks grouped by root (default) |
| [`bob notebooks sync`](notebooks.md#bob-notebooks-sync) | Write every generated notebook catalog |
| [`bob periods`](periods.md) | Manage period notes: weeks, quarters, years, and all time |
| [`bob periods brief`](periods.md#bob-periods-brief) | Print the agent review bundle for a week, quarter, or year |
| [`bob periods draft`](periods.md#bob-periods-draft) | Draft a period's Review section (never overwrites Bryan) |
| [`bob periods ensure`](periods.md#bob-periods-ensure) | Create missing period notes one week ahead |
| [`bob periods list`](periods.md#bob-periods-list) | List period notes with review states (default) |
| [`bob periods migrate`](periods.md#bob-periods-migrate) | Adopt the period-note tree (dry run by default) |
| [`bob periods show`](periods.md#bob-periods-show) | Show a period's live stats and child summaries |
| [`bob query`](query.md) | Run Dataview or Tasks queries against the vault |
| [`bob records`](records.md) | List, inspect, check, scaffold, and create or update configured Record Notes |
| [`bob records check`](records.md#bob-records-check) | Check configured Record Notes against their schemas |
| [`bob records init`](records.md#bob-records-init) | Scaffold a record type's notes and starter Base |
| [`bob records list`](records.md#bob-records-list) | List configured Record Note collections (default) |
| [`bob records new`](records.md#bob-records-new) | Create one Record Note from its configured schema |
| [`bob records show`](records.md#bob-records-show) | Show one record schema and its common values |
| [`bob records update`](records.md#bob-records-update) | Update one existing Record Note in place |
| [`bob ref`](ref.md) | Find, list, read, rename, and plan references for today; sync Highlights PDFs into them |
| [`bob vault-sync`](vault-sync.md) | Reconcile the vault through Git (default: run) or show status |

## Capture protocol

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`bob capture-complete`](capture-complete.md) | Complete the capture marker at the cursor |
| [`bob capture-drawers`](capture-drawers.md) | List the ALL-CAPS child drawers of a capture task |
| [`bob capture-parse`](capture-parse.md) | Explain what in-progress capture text currently means |
| [`bob capture-pomodoro-name`](capture-pomodoro-name.md) | Write a name onto an open unnamed Pomodoro |
| [`bob capture-pomodoros`](capture-pomodoros.md) | List today's Pomodoro ledger entries |
| [`bob capture-related`](capture-related.md) | List existing tasks and record notes a new capture may duplicate |
| [`bob capture-rewrite`](capture-rewrite.md) | Apply the capture grammar's automatic draft rewrites |
| [`bob capture-sections`](capture-sections.md) | List the non-Tasks sections of a capture note |
| [`bob capture-targets`](capture-targets.md) | List capture routes for inbox, area, project, and record notes |
| [`bob capture-task-id`](capture-task-id.md) | Write a block ID onto an open capture task |
| [`bob capture-tasks`](capture-tasks.md) | List the open tasks of a capture note |
| [`bob capture-templates`](capture-templates.md) | List, save, show, and manage saved capture templates |
| [`bob capture-templates clear`](capture-templates.md#bob-capture-templates-clear) | Clear the saved-template shelf |
| [`bob capture-templates delete`](capture-templates.md#bob-capture-templates-delete) | Delete templates by list index or content id |
| [`bob capture-templates list`](capture-templates.md#bob-capture-templates-list) | List saved capture templates (default) |
| [`bob capture-templates save`](capture-templates.md#bob-capture-templates-save) | Save a template definition without capturing a row |
| [`bob capture-templates show`](capture-templates.md#bob-capture-templates-show) | Print one template as a ready-to-insert draft |

## Full help

```text title="bob --help"
Bob tracks a daily Pomodoro ledger inside an Obsidian vault and keeps that
vault synced through Git. Commands follow the daily workflow: capture, review
(plan, freshness, ready), stats, run Pomodoros, reconcile tasks, and nightly
maintenance. Pass `--help` to any command, or run `bob help <command>`, for
its own options.

Usage: bob <COMMAND>

Daily workflow:
  capture      Capture tasks, bullets, record notes, and Pomodoro commands into
               the vault
  freshness    Walk the tiered freshness review queue
  plan         Show today's plan budget, Today's tasks, and NEXT/PENDING lanes
  pomodoro     Show Pomodoro status, print the tmux line, or notify on
               completion
  ready        Show each area/project note's Ready lane against the per-note cap
  stats        Show derived daily metrics as a glance, detail chart, or catalog
  types        Manage task types and explain task suggestions

Tasks and projects:
  projects     List and sync project notes via their ^prj tasks
  relations    List, hide, unhide, and rename relation labels
  task         Vault-wide task maintenance: archive, merge, move, reconcile,
               reroll, split

Vault:
  articles     Format and inspect article notes with bob-owned section numbers
  attachments  Copy files into the vault and show where copies came from
  nightly      Run nightly maintenance: vault-sync, task archive, articles,
               period notes, notebooks, vault-sync
  notebooks    Inspect or maintain notebook notes
  periods      Manage period notes: weeks, quarters, years, and all time
  query        Run Dataview or Tasks queries against the vault
  records      List, inspect, check, scaffold, and create or update configured
               Record Notes
  ref          Find, list, read, rename, and plan references for today; sync
               Highlights PDFs into them
  vault-sync   Reconcile the vault through Git (default: run) or show status

Integrations:
  clipboard    Diagnose clipboard history for counted capture
  gcal         Project Google Calendar events onto today's daily note
  gkeep        Drain the Google Keep inbox into Obsidian tasks
  gmail        Save Gmail threads as inert mail notes, linked from tasks

Setup:
  completion   Install and inspect shell completion for bob
  plugins      List and deploy Bob's custom Obsidian plugins

Capture protocol:
  capture-complete       Complete the capture marker at the cursor
  capture-drawers        List the ALL-CAPS child drawers of a capture task
  capture-parse          Explain what in-progress capture text currently means
  capture-pomodoro-name  Write a name onto an open unnamed Pomodoro
  capture-pomodoros      List today's Pomodoro ledger entries
  capture-related        List existing tasks and record notes a new capture may
                         duplicate
  capture-rewrite        Apply the capture grammar's automatic draft rewrites
  capture-sections       List the non-Tasks sections of a capture note
  capture-targets        List capture routes for inbox, area, project, and
                         record notes
  capture-task-id        Write a block ID onto an open capture task
  capture-tasks          List the open tasks of a capture note
  capture-templates      List, save, show, and manage saved capture templates

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version

Examples:
  bob capture buy milk @groceries   Capture a task into groceries.md
  bob capture '='                   Start the queued Pomodoro
  bob plan                          Show today's plan budget and lanes
  bob freshness                     List the review queue
  bob ready                         Show Ready lanes against the per-note cap
  bob stats                         Glance at derived daily metrics
  bob types                         List recently used task types
  bob task reconcile --dry-run      Preview task status reconciliation
  bob query --source '#project'     Print matching note paths
  bob vault-sync status --json      Print the last vault Git sync status

Run 'bob <command> --help' or 'bob help <command>' for more on a command.
```
